# Old reports with scores (fabricated)

Twelve made-up past reports, written the ways reports give scores: in a sentence, in brackets,
in a list, after "ציון", beside an abbreviation. No child, family or practitioner here is real.

Every score the finder should turn into a score tag is written `⟦7⟧` (`⟦7:block_design⟧` also names its measure); the tests take the marks
out and read the text without them. Every other number (an age, a date, a percentile, a count,
a room) is plain and must never become a score tag, and after the neutralizing nothing of it
stays (round 32, D-070).
